notes.text: The linked Shabbat passage has Yehoshua ben Kapposai written with kaf (כפוסאי), as the alternative to Yehoshua ben Ziruz in Ravin’s report. Hyman uses qof (קפוסאי). [Heilprin’s Kapposai entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3052&lang=en) also names Yehoshua as his son.
